events.verdict: Butler (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position during Barrett's (TOR) drive to the basket and absorbs the contact initiating by Barrett near the basket. As he swipes down, he avoids making any contact with Barrett's arm.
Butler (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends the drive and pass by Barrett (TOR).
Mitchell (TOR) extends his leg into Butler's (TOR) path and initiates illegal foot contact, which alters his driving shot attempt.
Poeltl (TOR) establishes himself in Butler's (MIA) path and absorbs the marginal contact as both players come together during the screen.
Poeltl (TOR) is retreating and bringing his arms into a vertical position as he defends Adebayo (MIA) at the end of the drive.
Barnes (TOR) cleanly deflects Adebayo's (MIA) pass and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Agbaji (TOR) legally contests Herro's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
The shot clock expires while the Raptors still have possession of the ball.
Adebayo (MIA) is established in Agbaji's (TOR) path and absorbs the contact during the screen.
Adebayo (MIA) is moving in the same direction alongside Barnes (TOR) when he briefly rests his hands on Barnes' body before immediately moving them.
